issues.message: Add at least one step
Input should be 'extract_fields', 'analyze_contract', 'compare_contracts', 'draft_document', 'deep_research', 'citation_check' or 'approval'
List should have at least 1 item after validation, not 0
Duplicate field: term
Input should be 'strict' or 'balanced'
String should have at least 3 characters
Step names start with a letter and use letters, digits, '_' or '-' only
Another step is already named 'SAME'
'later' is not an earlier step; only steps above this one can be used
'nope' is not an earlier step; only steps above this one can be used
A step cannot refer to itself
inputs.document_ids is required when inputs.source is 'documents'
inputs.step is required when inputs.source is 'step'
pick the baseline document to compare against
approvers: name at least one approver
approvers must be 'owner', 'any_member' or a list of user ids
Input should be 'documents' or 'case_law'
List should have at least 1 item after validation, not 0
value: the 'gt' condition needs a number
value: the 'equals' condition needs a value to compare with
path: dotted keys and list indexes only, e.g. data.analyses.0.issues
A workflow may have at most 12 steps on this server
